result.title: ReTRACE: Feedback-Guided LLM Agent in a Chemistry Harness for Retrosynthesis Planning
result.summary: Computer-aided retrosynthesis has advanced through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, but complex targets still require judgement over the whole route, where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \textbf{\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{A}nd \textbf{C}ontext-aware \textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) in a chemistry harness that integrates molecular tools, complementary single-step prediction engines, a purchasable starting-material library, a route memory and a multi-criterion route evaluator. Routes are judged by a new metric that combines programmatic checks with adversarial LLM review, and its verdicts are compared with a synthetic chemist's. The agent learns continually from evaluator feedback during search, diagnosing weak routes and backtracking to revise them. With Claude Opus 4.8, at least one of the top 10 routes proposed by ReTRACE passed the audit for 87.4\%, 95.0\% and 86.7\% of targets on the three benchmarks. Two prospective wet-lab syntheses show that ReTRACE route proposals can be converted into executable procedures after expert revision.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ReTRACE，一个把 LLM 置于「化学工具架」中的逆合成规划智能体，整合分子工具、单步预测引擎、可购原料库、路线记忆与多准则路线评估器，并让智能体在搜索中依据评估反馈诊断与回溯修正路线。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于化学规划这一远领域，但其「评估器反馈驱动诊断、回溯与状态修正」的搜索控制循环，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、停止/回溯决策与贡献分配提供概念类比，可供核查。
